title: Backpack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- main body of the backpack -->
  <rect x='22' y='28' width='56' height='56' rx='14' fill='#3d7fd6'/>
  <!-- lighter side panels for edge definition -->
  <rect x='22' y='28' width='10' height='56' rx='10' fill='#5a9de8'/>
  <rect x='68' y='28' width='10' height='56' rx='10' fill='#2f68b4'/>
  <!-- top flap -->
  <path d='M26 34 Q50 18 74 34 Q74 44 50 42 Q26 44 26 34 Z' fill='#4f92e2'/>
  <!-- flap rim highlight -->
  <path d='M28 38 Q50 30 72 38' stroke='#7fb8f0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front pocket -->
  <rect x='34' y='56' width='32' height='24' rx='7' fill='#e8b93a'/>
  <!-- pocket rim highlight -->
  <rect x='34' y='56' width='32' height='6' rx='3' fill='#f7d472'/>
  <!-- zipper line on pocket -->
  <path d='M38 68 Q50 62 62 68' stroke='#b88a1c' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- buckle/clip on flap -->
  <rect x='44' y='40' width='12' height='8' rx='3' fill='#f0f4f8'/>
  <rect x='47' y='42' width='6' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
  <!-- shoulder straps peeking at top -->
  <path d='M32 28 Q30 20 36 18' stroke='#2f68b4' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 28 Q70 20 64 18' stroke='#2f68b4' stroke-width='6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- handle loop -->
  <path d='M44 22 Q50 14 56 22' stroke='#3d7fd6' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
